UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile of an authenticated user identified by their Gmail account.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Lowercase Gmail address of the user.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was last updated.

Itinerary.title: Itinerary
Itinerary.description: A shared itinerary (roteiro) accessible and editable by all linked Gmail accounts.

title.description: Title of the itinerary, e.g., Natal.

coverImageData.description: Optional compressed data URL of the user-uploaded cover image.

ownerEmail.description: Lowercase Gmail address of the itinerary creator.

linkedEmails.description: Bounded list (1-25) of lowercase Gmail addresses with full collaboration access.

calendarSyncEnabled.description: Whether Google Calendar sync is suggested on event save.

notifyOnChanges.description: Whether Gmail notifications are suggested on date additions or updates.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when itinerary was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when itinerary was last updated.

ItineraryEvent.title: ItineraryEvent
ItineraryEvent.description: A scheduled date/activity inside a shared itinerary.

date.description: Event date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or empty string when open/unscheduled.

time.description: Start time in HH:MM 24h format, or empty string when open/unscheduled.

endTime.description: Optional end time in HH:MM format or empty string.

links.description: Bounded list (0-10) of external links attached to this event.

attachments.description: Bounded list (0-10) of PDF or image file metadata references.

googleCalendarEventId.description: Linked Google Calendar event ID for idempotent updates.

lastCalendarSyncAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest Google Calendar sync.

linkedEmails.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-25) matching parent itinerary linkedEmails.

createdByUid.description: UID of the user who created the event.

createdByEmail.description: Lowercase email of the user who created the event.

updatedByEmail.description: Lowercase email of the last user who modified the event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event was last updated.

ItineraryFile.title: ItineraryFile
ItineraryFile.description: Uploaded PDF or image attachment belonging to an itinerary event.

dataUrl.description: Base64 data URL of the PDF or compressed image.

linkedEmails.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-25) matching parent itinerary linkedEmails.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when file was uploaded.

ItineraryActivity.title: ItineraryActivity
ItineraryActivity.description: Audit entry of additions, edits, calendar syncs, or email alerts inside an itinerary.

actorEmail.description: Lowercase email of the user who triggered the action.

linkedEmails.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-25) matching parent itinerary linkedEmails.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/itineraries/{itineraryId}.description: Shared itineraries accessible to all linked Gmail accounts.

/itineraries/{itineraryId}/events/{event.description: Agenda items belonging to an itinerary.

/itineraries/{itineraryId}/files/{fileId.description: PDF and image attachments for itinerary events.

/itineraries/{itineraryId}/activity/{act.description: Shared activity log for an itinerary.
